items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: No, I don't want to deal with Hampton.

ctx.x: Did he go with Hampton? Yeah.

Because I said, man, you want to die? No, I don't want to deal with Hampton. We were in New York. And I came home. And the next thing I knew I got a word that Wilbert was playing with him. But he played with everybody. And he was a very dear friend. But nobody mentions his name, I hope. Remember that name, New Orleans.

You know what, a lot of guys who went on the road, and Earl King would do this to me, I'll be with him and he'll say, see that guy, he's a great saxophone player. Nobody knows what, because he was always, they left. They were always gone. Yeah. So we don't, for the cats who stayed, like Red Tyler, Red didn't go on the road a lot. He was on sessions, but we know him from his records he was on.
